1.

O Lord, how measureless Thy love to us is; How great the grace and favour Thou ever dost bestow upon us.

2.

Yet, Lord, what weakness Is manifest to Thee In us, whom Thou hast called To walk in Thy path.

3.

Thy love, nevertheless, abides, However we have acted, And Thee we ever find The same as Thou wast.

4.

O, that with Thee, our Lord, We constantly walked, Then would Thy glory Ever be revealed to us.

5.

Far more of Thy fulness We then should comprehend, Thee with all the heart worship, And walk in Thy ways.

6.

How sweet, however, then we find, When clouds that veiled Thee Have fled, Thou art the same, And never dost change.

7.

Thy love can assuredly Preserve us from falling, Until before God blameless Thy people Thou shalt place.
